title: Exploded after 2 months
text: Exploded after 2 months. Bought this from a big box store for a hundred bucks two months ago after moving into our new place. It worked perfectly for two months, then inexplicably today my husband heard popping noises and suddenly 10-12 cups of water is somehow streaming out the bottom. Damaged our floor just from the sheer amount of water. Water ran over to a surge protector which is now destroyed. Lovely waste of $100+, nevermind the damage it caused.
